extensionDescription.message: Continuous playback on YouTube and YouTube Music, with same-channel, queue and artist controls.

intro.message: Separate controls for YouTube and YouTube Music.

hint.message: Picks the first unvisited video from the latest loaded list. Press Play to start; Chrome may block autoplay with sound.

ready.message: Ready. Will switch when the video ends.

fetchError.message: YouTube did not return data. Please try again later.

parseError.message: Could not read YouTube data. Please reload the page.

channelError.message: Could not identify this video’s channel.

searching.message: Finding another video from this channel…

liveError.message: Only standard videos are supported. Live streams are not supported yet.

tabError.message: Could not read the channel’s Videos tab. YouTube may require sign-in or its layout may have changed.

listError.message: Could not read the channel’s video list. Please share this error and the video URL for troubleshooting.

exhausted.message: No unvisited videos remain in the loaded list. Clear history to watch them again.

unplayable.message: Could not find a playable video from the same channel.

timeout.message: YouTube took too long to respond. Click Next now to retry.

enabledStatus.message: Enabled. Will switch when the video ends.

unsupported.message: Only standard video watch pages (/watch) are supported.

connectionError.message: Open YouTube or YouTube Music. Reload the tab after installing or updating ChannelFlow.

unexpectedError.message: An error occurred. Please reload YouTube and try again.

preventAutoPauseHint.message: Confirms the YouTube Continue watching prompt in English or Vietnamese. Manual pause still works.

autoQualityLabel.message: Automatically select the highest available quality up to 2160p

musicIntro.message: Play your queue, or stay with the same artist or channel.

musicHint.message: Repeats matching loaded tracks. Open Up next if the queue is unavailable.

musicOpen.message: Start a song on YouTube Music to begin.

musicReady.message: Ready. Continues through your chosen music mode.

musicOff.message: ChannelFlow music switching is off. Music’s own playback settings still apply.

musicUnavailable.message: Could not control the Music player. Open Up next and try again.

musicArtistUnknown.message: Artist identity is unavailable. Open Up next or use queue mode.

musicNoMatch.message: No matching track in the loaded queue. Add tracks or choose another mode.

preventMusicPauseLabel.message: Automatically confirm inactivity prompts on YouTube Music
